title: No internet connection after area outage marked resolved
summary: Customer received SMS stating neighborhood outage was restored, but home devices cannot access internet. Has already toggled phone Wi-Fi.

messages.content: Hi there. I got an automated text about 2 hours ago saying the broadband outage in Springfield was resolved, but our internet is still completely offline.
Hello Sarah, thanks for reaching out to NexusTel Support. I can see your Fiber 500 connection. Have you tried checking your devices?

Yes, I've already turned Wi-Fi off and on across both my phone and laptop, but neither can load any webpages. I have critical work calls starting in 30 minutes, so I really need this fixed right away.
